verdict.rationale: Airweave's collections group data sources behind a single search endpoint, so search is scoped to a collection (airweave-docs-1, airweave-docs-2). Airweave Connect lets end users connect their own apps inside your product (airweave-docs-8), which suggests per-tenant collections are possible. However, no evidence documents explicit per-user, per-agent, or per-application scoping or any isolation guarantee against cross-tenant retrieval leakage. Missing for 10: documented per-user/agent/app scoping primitives, explicit tenant-isolation guarantees for retrieval, permission/RBAC enforcement docs, and independent corroboration.
